questions.key_step: Eliminate lambda to get alpha=5/7

questions.key_step: Divide by sqrt(x-3), square twice, test
questions.justification: Routine squaring chain; trap is x=3 and extraneous root.

questions.key_step: Divide by t^2, z=t-1/t
questions.justification: Palindromic-type substitution then positivity of t; routine multi-step.

questions.key_step: Discriminant condition for y, separate y=1
questions.justification: Standard range method with one special case.

questions.key_step: t=x^2 reduces to cubic; pair roots by modulus
questions.justification: Factor a cubic and order complex roots; routine, no insight.

questions.key_step: alpha^4+beta^4 in s and p gives quadratic in a
questions.justification: Power-sum expansion then Vieta on the unknown; routine.

questions.key_step: Cross-multiplication or subtraction for common root
questions.justification: Standard common-root elimination, numerical answer.

questions.key_step: Case split at 3 and 5 and check intervals
questions.justification: Casework with rejection of one candidate.

questions.justification: Polar form of complex roots with large powers; printed key wrong so trap for solvers.

questions.key_step: (n-5)^2-6 and count integers

questions.key_step: Vieta gives a and b, then new roots
